[1/6] Add autosave and three named save slots across terminal and Web Cyberdeck

impact_assessment.why: ADR-024 gave both interfaces one manual save file; players still lose progress if they forget to save and cannot keep more than one run.
impact_assessment.benefits: Crash-safe progress recovery, parallel runs, and a load menu that works in both interfaces without changing the campaign.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save schema and load semantics shared by CLI, web and storage; dependency: none; concurrency: single-user local files with atomic writes; state: existing single savegame.json must keep loading and terminal anti-replay must survive.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep slot 1 mapped to the legacy files, add explicit auto/manual ownership metadata, migrate on read, and cover legacy load, slot isolation and settlement cleanup with failing-first tests.

[1/4] Name, rename and delete save slots across the terminal and Web Cyberdeck

impact_assessment.why: Three slots shipped in ADR-025, but every checkpoint is still called SLOT 1/2/3 and stale runs cannot be cleared, so parallel runs are hard to tell apart.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can label runs, rename an archive entry without replaying it, and delete stale checkpoints; the slot archive becomes a usable library.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive save meta and new API/CLI verbs; dependency: none; concurrency: single-user local files rewritten atomically; state: rename must preserve the checkpoint and saved_at, delete must not touch the live run or other slots.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep names in additive meta, rewrite the same atomic payload on rename, require an explicit slot for delete, and cover legacy saves, name trimming, cross-slot isolation and the HTTP/CLI paths with failing-first tests.

[1/4] Record every settled run in the career dossier and surface it in CLI and Web

impact_assessment.why: The career profile tracks totals and best combo, but the RUN LEGACY moment disappears when the next run starts; players have no record of seeds, outcomes or per-run performance.
impact_assessment.benefits: A persistent run archive makes progression legible, gives slot labels context, and rewards replaying different seeds and story outcomes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: career.json gains an additive run_history field consumed by CLI/Web; dependency: none; concurrency: settlement remains one-shot under the existing guard; state: old careers must load with an empty history and the archive must stay bounded.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Append inside settle_career after the one-shot guard, cap the list, default missing fields on read, and cover victory/lockout records, old-career loading, capping, persistence and both displays with tests.
